name.zh-TW: 角色管理：建立一個新角色
name.en-US: Role Management: Create a New Role

title.zh-TW: 先想清楚要不要開新角色
title.en-US: First, decide whether you really need a new role

description.zh-TW: 角色開得愈多愈難管——半年後沒人記得「業務二」和「業務（新）」差在哪。開新角色之前，先看看現有角色是不是只差一兩個權限；如果是，考慮讓那個人同時具備兩個角色，而不是複製一份出來微調。
description.en-US: The more roles you create, the harder they are to manage. Six months later, nobody remembers how "Sales 2" differs from "Sales (New)". Before creating a new role, check whether an existing role is only one or two permissions off; if so, consider giving that person both roles instead of copying one and tweaking it.

title.zh-TW: 角色名稱要讓別人看得懂，不只是你
title.en-US: Choose a role name others can understand, not just you

description.zh-TW: 這個名稱會出現在用戶管理的角色欄和角色切換選單裡，接手的人只會看到這個名字。用職務或業務範圍命名（例如「合約審核人員」），不要用「測試用」「暫時」「新角色1」這種只有當下有意義的名字。名稱不能重複，撞名時系統會擋下來。如果新角色跟某個現有角色差不多，用旁邊的「以既有角色為範本」複製它的權限當起點，再調整差異。
description.en-US: This name appears in the Roles column in User Management and in the Switch Role menu, and it's the only thing whoever takes over will see. Name it after a job title or area of responsibility (for example, "Contract Reviewer"), not something that only makes sense right now, like "Test", "Temporary" or "New Role 1". Names must be unique; the system blocks duplicates. If the new role is similar to an existing one, use "Start from an Existing Role" next to it to copy that role's permissions as a starting point, then adjust the differences.

title.zh-TW: 沒有「檢視」，其他三個都沒有意義
title.en-US: Without "View", the other three are meaningless

description.zh-TW: 每個功能有四種權限：檢視、新增、修改、刪除。檢視是其他三種的前提——勾新增、修改或刪除時會自動勾上檢視，取消檢視則會一併取消另外三個。標「不適用」的格子是這個功能本來就沒有該項操作。勾群組列等於勾底下全部功能，表頭的勾選框可以整欄套用。設定的原則是從最少開始：先只給檢視，之後真的需要再加。權限給多了很難發現，給少了對方馬上會來問。
description.en-US: Each feature has four permissions: View, Add, Edit and Delete. View is a prerequisite for the other three: selecting Add, Edit or Delete automatically selects View, and clearing View also clears the other three. A cell marked "N/A" means the feature simply doesn't have that action. Selecting a group row selects every feature under it, and the checkboxes in the header apply to the whole column. The rule of thumb is to start with as little as possible: grant View only at first, and add more later when it's really needed. Too many permissions are hard to notice, but with too few, the person will come and ask you right away.

title.zh-TW: 「重設」只還原畫面，按「儲存」才會建立角色
title.en-US: "Reset" only restores the form; the role is created only when you click "Save"

description.zh-TW: 勾得一團亂想重來時，用「重設」把表單還原成剛進來的樣子；這隻按鈕只影響眼前這張表單。按「儲存」之後角色才真正建立，接著到用戶管理把角色指派給人，對方下次登入就會生效。還沒儲存就離開這一頁，系統會先問你要不要放棄。
description.en-US: If your selections get messy and you want to start over, use "Reset" to restore the form to how it was when you opened it; this button only affects the form in front of you. The role is actually created only after you click "Save". Then go to User Management to assign the role to people, and it takes effect the next time they log in. If you leave this page without saving, the system first asks whether you want to discard your changes.
